turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale. Owen's zero was entered in the gradebook before anyone called me, and he found out on his phone in the middle of class. Withdraw it, and tell me why it was entered.
I don't think this is productive.
"I don't think this is productive." I'm writing that down. Why was the zero entered before anyone called me?
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.
You asked for this meeting, Hale. Is the zero coming off, yes or no? If you walk out of here without answering, I'm going to the principal's office next.
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.

"I'm done here." I'm writing that down, along with the time. Procedure 4.2 says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered, nobody called me, and I'm going upstairs now unless you give me one reason the zero stands.
